hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try the question with $y = 6$: which number times $3$ makes $6$? It is $2$. Now ask the same question for $27$.
This time the output $y$ is known and the input $x$ is missing, so you work backward.
Put $27$ in for $y$ to get $27 = 3x$. Divide both sides by $3$.
Dividing gives $27 \div 3 = 9$, so the value of $x$ is $9$.

explanation: Replace $y$ with $27$ in the rule, which gives $27 = 3x$.
Divide both sides by $3$ to undo the multiplication and leave $x$ alone.
Working out the division on the left gives $x = 27 \div 3 = 9$.
Check: $3 \times 9 = 27$ is true, so the answer is $x = 9$.
